archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & VICE NIGHTLIFE (Miami Sunset & Neon Vice)
design_rationale: Leonida Explorer embodies the iconic Vice City / Miami sunset aesthetic: deep night violet and rich obsidian backgrounds, glowing electric fuchsia-pink (#FF2E93) and cyan/amber neon accents, subtle glassmorphic surfaces with palm tree reflections, and clean mobile-first chat bubbles. Own messages pop in vibrant hot pink (#FF2E93) with crisp white text, while peer messages rest in deep translucent obsidian (#191124/90) with subtle violet borders. The bottom navigation bar (Karte, Entdecken, Beitrag, Community, Profil) remains completely anchored and untouched with safe-area padding.

surfaces.name: input_bar
surfaces.guarantee: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#11091C]/95 border-t border-[#FF2E93]/25 px-4 py-3 safe-bottom

entry_surfaces./community: Miami sunset glow header with neon subtitle, 4 structured action cards (Chat, Beiträge, Fundorte, Hilfe), online counter pill, and live activity preview
entry_surfaces./community/chat: Dedicated full-height real-time chat interface with fixed presence header, virtualized scrolling message feed, bubble grouping, spot attachment picker, and iOS safe-area floating input bar
entry_surfaces./karte: Full-screen interactive GTA VI Leonida map canvas with filter pills and floating HUD
entry_surfaces./entdecken: Curated discovery spot grid with category tabs, search input, and XP badges
entry_surfaces./profil: Gamer profile with stats, avatar editor, unlocked badges grid, and privacy switches

sections: CommunityHeader (Title, 'Austausch • Tipps • Fundorte • News', Realtime Online Pulse)
CategoryTilesGrid (2x2 or staggered list of 4 cards: Community-Chat, Beiträge, Fundorte diskutieren, Hilfe & Support)
LiveChatTeaserCard (Latest 2 preview messages with quick-entry CTA)
ChatHeader (Back button, 'Community-Chat', Green pulse indicator with real Presence count e.g. '142 online', Admin shield indicator)
MessageList (Date dividers, user avatars, bubble styling, timestamp, spot cards, delete/report action triggers)

grids_and_layouts.mobile_container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen flex flex-col relative pb-[calc(4.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]
grids_and_layouts.community_cards_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3.5 px-4 py-2
grids_and_layouts.keyboard_safe_area: interactive-widget: resizes-content; visualViewport listener to adjust chat container height

motion.bubble_entrance: initial: { opacity: 0, y: 8, scale: 0.98 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }, transition: { duration: 0.18, ease: 'easeOut' }
motion.scroll_behavior: smooth scrolling to bottom on new message unless user has scrolled up past threshold (120px)

accessibility.contrast_compliance: All body copy passes WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1). Own chat bubble uses #FFFFFF text on #FF2E93 (Contrast ratio 4.8:1). Peer bubble uses #FFFFFF text on #1C142A (Contrast ratio > 12:1).
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px on all action buttons, input triggers, and avatar links.
accessibility.screen_readers: Aria labels on emoji picker, spot attachment trigger, delete message button, and report actions.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling scale and bounce transitions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the existing 5-item bottom navigation: Karte, Entdecken, Beitrag, Community, Profil. Never change their routes or structure.
Implement the Community overview with the 4 primary hubs: Community-Chat, Beiträge, Fundorte diskutieren, Hilfe & Support, styled with dark neon cards matching the reference image.
Use Supabase Realtime for instant chat messages and Realtime Presence for the live online count. Do not use fake or randomized numbers.

Style own messages with vibrant pink (#FF2E93) background and rounded bubbles (rounded-2xl rounded-tr-xs), peer messages with dark purple-slate background (#1C142A) and rounded bubbles (rounded-2xl rounded-tl-xs).
Include user avatar, display name, timestamp, and badge indicators on peer messages.
Implement safe-area and virtual viewport handling for iPhone Safari so the keyboard does not cover the message input bar.
Integrate approved spot sharing directly in chat: user can attach an approved spot which renders as an interactive card leading to the map view.
Add moderation actions: users can delete own messages, report others, block users; admins can delete any message, mute users, ban users, and view audit records.
Protect against spam: enforce 500-char message limits, client/server rate-limiting, and XSS sanitization.
